name: FKK-Camping Liga Völs
beschreibung: The naturist campsite 'Liga Völs' is located in the municipality of Völs, about five kilometers west of Innsbruck. The surroundings are characterized by the mountain backdrop of the Nordkette and the valleys of the Stubaital. The nearby region is home to the ski areas Axamer Lizum and the Stubaier Gletscher as well as hiking trails in the valley and at higher elevations. The campsite is designed for textile-free camping. Amenities include sanitary facilities, a heated swimming pool, and a restaurant. The facility is geared toward quiet, nature-oriented use and offers space for relaxation.
